objective: block fwd+bwd_ms (primary), fwd_ms (primary), out_err vs fp64 (second objective, Pareto), peak_gb (tiebreak)

baseline.note: liger RMSNorm + eager router + moe_per_expert; gate_up (E,2I,H), down (E,H,I)

noise_floor.promotion_rule: fwd+bwd must improve by >1% (about 6 sigma) on HELD-OUT shapes; target 10%

standing_slices: flips_vs_fp64 must not exceed today's stack (1133 per 65536 tokens)
per-expert counts must equal bincount(indices) and sum to T*K
router bias update must fire exactly once per step (backward must not re-run the router)
stop_target: 1.10x on held-out block fwd+bwd with accuracy no worse than baseline
